## `#[AsUiBehavior]`

`Semitexa\PlatformUi\Attribute\AsUiBehavior`

Applies to: class

| parameter | type | required |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | yes |
| `ui` | `string` | no |
| `script` | `string` | no |
| `options` | `array` | no |
| `a11y` | `array` | no |
| `requires` | `array` | no |

```php
#[AsUiBehavior(
    name: 'platform.modal',
    ui: 'modal',
    script: 'platform-ui:js:behaviors',
    options: [

    a11y: ['focus-trap', 'esc-dismiss', 'aria-modal', 'scroll-lock'],
)]
```
